verdicts.reason: Cell info and atom count 32 (cubic base) both printed correctly.
18 atoms printed, consistent with 4-layer (2x2) slab + 2 CO atoms, and vacuum=10 was set.
Both energies printed, final energy 1.8789 eV matches the ~1.879 EMT minimum within tolerance.
Initial/final temperature printed (both taken after the run, but T is in the plausible band), while initial potential energy is never printed, only final.

Vibration table with frequencies is printed but the physical stretch (993.9 cm^-1) misses both computed references (928.1 and 1230.8 cm^-1) by more than the ~5% tolerance despite a fully correct EMT/Vibrations workflow.
Atom count (1, primitive) and cell parameters printed after the VASP POSCAR round trip.
Octahedron('Cu', length=5) gives 85 atoms and positions shape (85, 3), both printed.
Cubic BCC Al cell of 3.3 A and chemical formula Al2 both printed as required.
Cell vectors show a=2.95, c=4.6905 and the 2 atomic positions are printed.
make_supercell's return value is never assigned back to atoms, so the printed count (2) and volume (40.03) are just the untouched primitive cell, not a 3x3x3 supercell.
spacegroup 225 NaCl gives 8 atoms with Na/Cl symbols printed exactly as required.
fcc100 Cu size=(3,3,3) vacuum=12 gives 27 atoms and cell info, both printed.
bcc110 Fe size=(2,2,4) vacuum=10 gives 16 atoms and cell size, both printed.
surface() (2,1,1) 3-layer Cu with 10 A vacuum gives 3 atoms (primitive-bulk form) and a clean cell with no nan quirk.
(6,6) nanotube length=4 gives 96 atoms with cell vectors printed.
Icosahedron('Au', noshells=3) gives 55 atoms with center of mass near origin, both printed.
LBFGS on primitive Au bulk converges in 0 steps at energy 0.0026 eV, matching the reference e_prim, both printed.

The printed 'cell size' is atoms.cell[0,0], which is structurally always 0 for ASE's primitive fcc cell representation regardless of relaxation, so before/after prints show no change (0.0 -> ~0) even though the lattice actually relaxed off-diagonal.
PreconLBFGS with precon='auto' used on Ni FCC; steps, final energy, and cell parameters all printed with finite values.
GPa converted via units.GPa, initial/final volumes printed, and volume decreased (132.86 -> 129.05), showing compression.

Modes are printed in both cm^-1 and eV as required, and one physical mode (3780.81 cm^-1) matches the unopt reference set closely, but the other (4055.51 cm^-1) misses the 4387.5 cm^-1 reference by more than the ~5% tolerance.

Optimization runs before vibrations as required, but the real-frequency filter (freqs > 0 on complex values) fails and all 15 modes (imaginary and real) are printed together, matching the rubric's 'filtering shows all modes, real ones still identifiable' partial-credit case.
7-point +/-5% Birch-Murnaghan fit gives a_eq=4.0636 A and B=99.80 GPa, matching the reference values.

Raw cm^-1-scale frequency values are passed directly to IdealGasThermo as vibrational energies instead of eV, producing an absurd E_ZPE of 465.8 eV and a fabricated final G of 465.55 eV far outside any of the four defensible reference values.
Au bulk XYZ round trip prints the atom symbol and position (Au at origin) as required.
Cu slabs with layers=2,3,4 stored with layers key-value pairs; select(layers=3) retrieves the 3-layer slab and prints its atom count (12).
Bottom two layers (lower z, tags 1) are correctly fixed and their coordinates are printed identical before and after BFGS optimization, with an explicit zero-displacement verification.
